note.after_visit_summary: You've been feeling down for about three months, with low energy, trouble sleeping, poor appetite, and loss of interest in activities you used to enjoy. You've also lost about eight pounds without trying. There's no sign of bipolar disorder or suicidal thoughts. Your PHQ-9 score shows moderate depression, and your anxiety is mild. You're starting sertraline 25 mg by mouth each day for one week, then increasing to 50 mg each day. Take it with breakfast. It may take 4-6 weeks to feel better. You're also being referred to therapy for weekly sessions. Keep the safety plan card we gave you—if you ever have thoughts of hurting yourself, call or text 988 or go to the nearest emergency room. We'll see you back in four weeks on October 19th to check how the medicine is working. Your prescription will be sent to Lakeview Pharmacy on 4120 Belmont Avenue.
